Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling through the intersection when the vehicle was struck on the driver's side by Driver 2, who had
entered from the cross street. Driver 1 reported neck strain and was evaluated at the scene. The injury is consistent
with the forces expected in a collision of this type. Driver 2 gave a statement that matched Driver 1's account of how
the crash occurred, and two independent witnesses on the adjacent corner described the same sequence of events.
Scene photographs show damage to the driver's side door and quarter panel that lines up with the reported point of
impact. A Passenger was also present in Driver 1's vehicle at the time, and officers confirmed this through both
witness accounts and statements given at the scene. Some small scratches on the rear bumper appear older than the
current damage and were noted for the record but are not believed to relate to this crash. Records confirm that Driver
1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle involved.
